subject.title: ACP session identity stuck in "pending" state after gateway restart storm, causing messages to be unrouted to bound ACP agent

question: Should ACP restart recovery prefer a status/liveness-backed persistent-session re-ensure path while keeping ensure-sourced IDs provisional, or should pending identities with stable IDs be treated as resolved immediately?
rationale: The source-backed bug is credible, but the permanent recovery contract changes persisted ACP session semantics and overlaps adjacent startup/recovery work.

options.title: Status-Backed Recovery
options.body: Keep ensure-created IDs provisional, probe or recreate live runtime state for persistent bound sessions, and require restart-channel proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Resolve Pending IDs
options.body: Treat pending identities with stable IDs as resolved, accepting the risk that stale ensure IDs become authoritative without status confirmation.

options.title: Defer To Adjacent ACP Work
options.body: Wait for the open startup reconcile PR and any follow-up warm-restore work, then re-check whether this persistent restart-storm path remains uncovered.

recommendation.title: Status-Backed Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ensure-created IDs provisional, probe or recreate live runtime state for persistent bound sessions, and require restart-channel proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history in the ACP control-plane recovery and runtime-handle ensure code that would own the contract decision.
